text: In Victorian London, Dr. Henry Jekyll, impatient to marry his fiancée Muriel, believes every man holds both good and evil, and [drinks a concoction meant to free his evil side|wrong|meddling with life itself]. He becomes Edward Hyde, [a sadistic man who indulges every desire|threat|the enemy within], and torments the bar singer Ivy Pierson. Soon [a cat killing a bird|images|animals and birds] is enough to change him, and [he can no longer control the transformations|rules|the body changes].
